question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Leela was in class when the big fight happened. So, if you want to know the details, You should ask her, you will get the truth __given by somebody who is directly involved and therefore likely to be accurate.__
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"straight from the horse's mouth"** means getting information directly from the original or most reliable source. (सीधे स्रोत से प्राप्त जानकारी) • **Example: **To be sure about the news, you should hear it straight from the horse's mouth. • **"With kid gloves"** refers to treating someone very gently or carefully. (बहुत ही नरमी से व्यवहार करना) • **Example: **He handled the delicate situation with kid gloves. • **"Shooting off the cuff"** means speaking without preparation or thinking. (बिना तैयारी के बोलना) • **Example: **He was shooting off the cuff during the entire meeting. • **"Calling a spade a spade"** means speaking directly and bluntly about something, even if it is unpleasant. (सच्चाई को स्पष्ट रूप से बताना) • **Example: **She is known for calling a spade a spade, regardless of the consequences. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **With kid gloves **(बहुत ही नरमी से व्यवहार करना): Treating someone very gently or carefully. • **Example:** He handled the delicate situation with kid gloves. • **Shooting off the cuff **(बिना तैयारी के बोलना ): Speaking without preparation or thinking. • **Example: **He was shooting off the cuff during the entire meeting. • **Calling a spade a spade **(सच्चाई को स्पष्ट रूप से बताना ): Speaking directly and bluntly about something. • **Example: **She is known for calling a spade a spade, regardless of the consequences. 3f:T8dd, The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Psychology.
